diagnosis: The initial generic-path condition classified legacy concatenated wide-head models (readout width equal to an integer multiple of recurrent width) as independent M models and rejected their established optimized Q8/Q16 precision paths.
repair: Keep the specialized wide-head path when M is a positive integer multiple of R. Route other M != R shapes through the generic path; the added M>R non-multiple Q8 regression exercises that route.
classification: Implementation compatibility failure, not a source-data issue or resource failure.
